title: CLO Alumni Discount: Supporting Your Transition to the Professional World
content: Congratulations on your graduation! To support the next generation of designers, **CLO offers a special 50% discount for recent graduates.** This initiative aims to help you bridge the gap between your studies and your professional career by providing affordable access to our software. **What is the Alumni Discount?** Eligible graduates can receive **50% off** on both monthly and annual subscriptions. * **Duration:** Valid for one full year. * **Automatic Renewal:** After 12 months, your subscription will renew at the regular price unless canceled. ⚠️ Important: This discount is not compatible with active Student Subscriptions. You must wait for your student license to expire before applying. **Eligibility & Required Documentation** To qualify for this program, you must have been enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited university or school. Your graduation date must be within the **last six months.** You are required to provide one of the following official documents to verify your status: * **University Degree or Official Certificate:** This document must include your full name, the name of the institution, the date of completion, and the official signature/seal of the university. * **Official Graduation Letter:** A formal letter from your university confirming the successful completion of your program. **Note:** You must have a registered individual CLO account before applying. The coupon can be applied to new subscriptions or the next billing cycle of an existing one. **Application Steps** Follow these steps to request your discount: 1. **Prepare your files:** Ensure your proof of graduation is in a digital format (PDF or high-quality image). 2. **Submit a request:** Visit our **Contact Us** page and submit your request through the [**General Support** section](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/general). 3. **Include Required Details** : In your message, you must: 1. Attach your official graduation documentation. 2. Provide the email address associated with your CLO account. 3. Specify if you prefer the Monthly or Annual plan 4. **Wait for verification:** Our team will review your documentation. Once approved, you will receive a response directly within your support ticket containing the specific steps to follow to get your discount. **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)** **Can I apply if I graduated more than six months ago?** Unfortunately, no. This specific program is designed for very recent graduates. Your graduation or completion date must be within the six-month window prior to your application. **What happens if I cancel my subscription mid-year?** * **Monthly Plan:** The discount is tied to an active, continuous subscription. If you cancel it, you will immediately lose the 50% benefit and you will not be able to reactivate it for the remainder of that year. * **Annual Plan:** If you cancel the auto-renewal of your annual license, you will still enjoy the access you paid for until the end of the 12-month period, but the license will not renew for the following year. **Does the discount apply to both Monthly and Annual plans?** Yes. You can choose the plan that best fits your needs. The 50% reduction applies to the total price of the Annual plan or to each of the 12 monthly payments of the Monthly plan. **Can I use this discount if I already have an active subscription?** Yes, if you are already an Individual subscriber, the discount will be applied to your next billing cycle once verified. However, please note that this discount cannot be applied to active Student Subscriptions. If you are a student, you must wait for your current license to expire before applying for the Alumni Discount. **What happens after the one-year discount period ends?** Once the 12-month discount period is over, your subscription will automatically renew at the regular price unless you choose to cancel it before the renewal date.
content_description: Unlock your potential as a recent graduate with CLO's exclusive 50% discount on software subscriptions, designed to help you transition from student to professional designer.

title: Avatar Properties
content: **Set the properties of the avatar.** ### 1. Click an avatar with Select/Move tool. 2. Click an avatar. →The properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust each properties below as needed. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | **Name /** **Item NO.** | Enter a name and an item number of the avatar. **Tech Pack** **(CLO-SET)** | Set whether to include avatar in the Tech Pack or not. **Body Styling** | **Style Configurator** | Set the appearance of the avatar. You can manually set the color of hair, skin, underwear, eyebrows, Eye and lips by clicking the Style Configurator button on the right. **Eye Control** ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=Kw_eMEWqBpsPJlNX&t=1647) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CwB8_ad328M&t=1647s)) | Adjust the position of the avatar's eyes horizontally or vertically. **📝****Note:** This option is only supported for the new avatars available starting with version 7.2. **Surface** | **Skin Offset** | Adjust the distance between the avatar and the garment. Since the avatar and the garment consist of the meshes, a very high value of particle distance and low value of Skin Offset can cause the avatar to protrude out from under the garment. To prevent this, the default Skin Offset value is set to 3mm, which is the proper value for creating a garment. When you fit your garment accurately or create a fitted garment, lower the value of the Skin Offset. **📝****Note:** Leave the default value until you almost finish your garment, since the simulation is being slow when you lower the Skin Offset of the avatar and the Particle Distance of the garment. **Friction** | Increase the friction value to prevent a garment slipped away while draping or animating. **Static** | The friction when a garment is in stationary position. **Kinetic** | The friction when a garment is moving. **Soft Body Simulation** | Apply deformable body simulation to express skin elasticity. This option is available on CLO's default adult avatar, and can only be simulated with garments. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** Enables softbody simulation for custom avatars without skeletons. _* Soft Body Simulation cannot be executed on a Custom Avatar if the mesh contains**holes** or **self-intersections**._ **📝****Note:** Soft body simulation is reflected when recording animation to enable realistic expression, and soft body simulation can also be applied to 3D dummy or scan files converted to CLO avatars. ([![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701355515545)](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=gH3afGW0Szdn4nrZ&t=1881) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRkb4MR0dP0&t=1881s)) **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48890535328537)** ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51882814533785) NVIDIA GPU is supported starting from version 2025.2. **Divide Mesh** | Adjust the number of the avatar's meshes to smooth the surface of the avatar. Be aware to use this feature when it is necessary. The higher you set the meshes, the bigger the size of the file can cause the slower speed of the program. E.g. This works best when you drape a fitted garment such as leggings since the meshes of the avatar appear. **Material** | Set the [Material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures) of the avatar.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for customizing avatar properties, including appearance adjustments, friction settings, and soft body simulations to enhance garment fitting and animation in CLO 3D.

title: Register Pose/Motion
content: ## **New in 2024.2** #### **You can easily register the pose or motion from an FBX file as a file compatible with CLO avatars. ![Register Pose.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075492713753) ** #### 1. Click the Main Menu » Avatar » **Register Pose/Motion** menu. 2. Select the type to register, either **Pose** or **Motion**. 3. Open the FBX file by clicking on the ![open.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075383168153) **Open** button. 4. Select the Gender of the compatible CLO avatar and select the Shoe Type for female. **📝****Note:** If the FBX file's joint names do not match the CLO avatar's, it can only be saved and cannot be registered as the CLO-compatible file. 5. For motion, switch to Animation mode to play loaded motion as needed. 6. Click the **Save** button to save as the Pose(POS) or Motion(MTN) file.

title: How to Solve "Error Code 400" Login Failure
content: This article explains how to solve login failures due to "Error Code: 400" and/or "Error Code: 10002". **Technical Background** Starting in March 2024, [the CLO team has integrated the different accounts of users](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce) using CLO software, CLO-SET, and CONNECT into one, and the CLO software have changed the login via CLO-SET webpage instead of entering ID and password in the login window. This policy will be applied from CLO version 2024.0, and previously released CLO 7.x or 6.x versions will run by entering ID and password. After the account integration, if the previously-used-user-login-information and the newly-integrated-user-information do not match, or if old-user-information is stored in the web browser being used, the CLO software login will fail and an error message will be displayed. **Problem Situations** ![001_ErrorCode_400.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36701673887641) ![002_now_signed_in_to_CLO-SET.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36701673892761) * Launched CLO, but get an error message instead of logging in. * Successfully logged in to CLO-SET on a web browser, but get an error message. * * * **Causes and Solutions** **In case of security app blocks CLO's internet connection** * If an antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program installed on your computer blocks the CLO software from communicating with the Internet, CLO login will fail. * Change the Internet connection of CLO software to "Allow" in the detailed settings of your antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program, and then run the CLO software again. **CLO software does not have sufficient file read and write permissions** * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697) to grant administrator rights to the CLO software and then run CLO again. **CLO-SET password error** * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/29936192175129) to reset your CLO-SET password and then run CLO again. **Web browser security policy or web browser cache error** * Web browsers with strict security policies or specific web browsers may have problems accessing the CLO-SET webpage. In this case, please try using a different web browser instead of the one you were using. Also, check again your web browser's security settings. * You may be experiencing problems logging into CLO-SET due to an outdated web browser cache. In this case, clear your cache and try logging in again. This [saved-search](https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&oq=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOdIBCDg1OTFqMGoxqAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8) will help. **CLO software configuration error** * The internal configuration and settings of the CLO software may have been damaged during the CLO Live Update and install. * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/16218721000601) to completely uninstall the CLO software and fresh install it using the latest installer. Don't forget to back up your working files to a safe place before uninstalling CLO software. * * * **Read More** * Learn more about [CLO-SET Account Integration](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce) here. See also [CLO Account Integration User Guide](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/28934650069785). * If you have followed the steps above but are still unable to log in, please send us your screenshot or error code via [**Contact Us**](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/technical).
content_description: This web page provides guidance on resolving login failures associated with "Error Code: 400" and "Error Code: 10002" following the integration of user accounts into the CLO-SET platform.

Click on the ![add folder.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357829657) **Add Folder** button at the top in POM tab in Object Browser. 2. Edit the folder name and then click away or hit Enter key to apply the changes. * Afterwards, double-click on the folder name to rename it. 3. Click on the ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357840665) **Add** button within folder to add new POM within a folder. 4. Click on the ![arrow.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543329543321)**Arrow** within the Folder to collapse all the POM in the folder. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Move** 1. Drag and drop the POMs between the different folders to move them to another folder. * Hold down the Shift key to select multiple POMs at once and move them all. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Delete** 1. Click on the ![delete.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357842329) **Delete** button to delete an entire folder or POMs within a folder. **📝****Note:** If there are active POMs within the folder a pop up will come up asking you; _If you would like to delete the POMs or move them to the default folder._ #### #### **View Graded Sizes** When Grading is applied to pattern, you will be able to view or hide different graded sizes within the Object Browser POM to improve visibility. When a pattern has grading applied the Graded sizes will automatically appear within the POM Object browser. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55674683001881) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/B3UdATm9Ylc) 1. Click on the size to hide it easily. 2. Click on the size again to quickly reactivate it.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide to the new features in CLO 2024.2 that enhance the organization and management of Points of Measure (POM) within the POM object browser.

title: Flatten
content: **Extract Patterns based on lines and shapes created on an Avatar.** **** **📝****Note:** * The Flattening function only extracts closed shapes as Patterns. * Since version 2024.2, the 2D pattern position and rotation are more aligned with the pattern placement on the 3D avatar. It is recommended to use CLO avatar for extracting the ideal pattern with front and back positions in the 2D window. When using a non-CLO avatar (eg. FBX) or missing the avatar, it is possible to lead to a non-ideal pattern position in the 2D window. #### 1. In the 3D toolbar, press and hold the **![3D Pen Avatar On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55637066431513)3D Pen (Avatar)** and switch to the ![Flatten On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948392732569) **Flatten.** **** 2. Hover the mouse over the shape to be extracted as Pattern. 3. Select all areas to be extracted by holding Shift on the keyboard, then clicking on the desired areas. 4. Press**Enter** on the keyboard. → The selected areas on the Avatar are converted to patterns and appear in both the 3D and 2D windows. → Sewing lines are automatically established for adjacent Patterns. 5. Hold down **Shift** and press **Enter.** → The intersecting area is flattened into a single pattern.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for extracting closed shapes as patterns from an Avatar, ensuring optimal alignment and positioning for both 2D and 3D applications.

title: Contest FAQs
content: **Q: Is a CLO-SET account required to participate in this contest?** A: Yes, participants must have a CLO-SET account to upload their contest entries. **Q: Can I combine this software with other programs?** A: Yes, you can use other software in conjunction. But CLO or Marvelous Designer must have been used. **Q: Which license type is required for this contest?** A: You must use a CLO individual, CLO student license, or a trial license (Enterprise licenses are not permitted). _**Important Note:** CLO strictly prohibits the use of unauthorized versions of the software. Entries submitted using unauthentic versions will be disqualified._ **Q: What happens if I miss the contest submission deadline?** A: You should submit your completed work as soon as possible. While we may consider late entries, acceptance is not guaranteed. **Q: Am I allowed to re-enter the contest after submitting my design once?** A: Users may upload a total of 5 entries per person for the contest _If you have any questions, please reach out to us via_[ _Contact US_](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) _._

title: Avatar (AVT) Open/Add/Save
content: **List of Contents** **Open/Add Avatar** **Save Avatar** **** Model (*.dae or *.obj), sizing data (*.avs), pose (*.pos), motion (*.mtn), accessory (*.acc), bounding volume (*.pan), all avatar-related files such as arrangement points (*.arr) can be saved and loaded into one file (*.avt). **** #### **Open/Add Avatar** 1. Click the File ▶ Open/Add ▶ **Avatar** in the top menus. 2. Select an avatar file. → Open/Add Avatar pop-up window appears. 3. Set the details and click **OK**. **Load Type** | Open | Load your avatar. ---|---|--- Add | Add your avatar. Load as Morph Target | Load the avatar as a morph target. **Translation** | X | Move horizontally based on the center of the 3D garment window. Y | Move vertically based on the center of the 3D garment window. Z | Move forward and backward based on the center of the 3D garment window. Unit | Select the unit of travel distance. **📝 Note:** When adding an avatar, arrangement point is maintained individually for each avatar. **** #### **Save Avatar** 1. Click the File ▶ Save As ▶ **Avatar** in the top menus. → An open file window appears. 2. Specify the location to save the garment file and enter a name and click **Save** to save it. **📝 Note:** * If multiple avatars are loaded, select one avatar and save it as an *.avt file. * When changing the file type to **Encrypted Avatar File(*.avte)** in the Avatar Save window, save it as an encrypted file that cannot be restored to other 3D files and avatar files (AVT).
content_description: This web page provides instructions for opening, adding, and saving avatar files in various formats, facilitating the management of avatar-related data in 3D modeling applications.

title: Does CLO offer student discounts?
content: **Question** Does CLO offer student discounts? **Answer** Yes, we offer a 50% discount on an Individual plan to eligible high school, college, and university students worldwide. Discounted price will be $25 USD/month or $225 USD/year. **Important Note:** To receive the student discount, you must verify your student status before starting your trial. If you fail to do so, you will not be eligible for the discount. **Student Eligibility** To qualify for a student discount, you must be at least 13 years old and enrolled in one of the following: * University or college - full-time students in an accredited university or college that offers degrees. * Primary or secondary school - full-time students in an accredited primary or secondary school. **Important Note:** The CLO Student Discount is limited to 4 years. If still enrolled after 4 years proof of continued enrollment is required for an additional 2 year extension of the Student Discount once. **I'm eligible. How can I get the student discount?** Please check if your student email is already approved with CLO: [**Student Eligibility Check**](https://clo3d.com/en/student-eligibility) * **When your school domain is already approved** , 1. 1. Add your student email. 2. The **USE EMAIL ADDRESS** button will be activated. Click on the button and create your account. 3. Your account will be automatically applied to the student discount. (You can see the discounted price on your checkout page after the subscription button.) * **If your school domain is not approved or you don't have a student email address,** 1. 1. Go to the [**SIGN UP**](https://style.clo-set.com/en/account/signup?returnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fclo3d.com%2Fauth%2Fsignin%3FredirectTo%3D%2F) page and select Individual. 2. Create your CLO account using either your student email address (if available) or your personal email address. 3. If using a personal email please provide a letter from your school stating they do not provide students with school email addresses After verifying your account, please [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) and submit one of the following documents: * School ID card with a valid date. * Official enrollment verification statement issued within the last 6 months. * Tuition statement for the current year/semester. Our support team will review your documents and apply for the discount if approved. * **If you already have an account with us,** Simply [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) and submit your proof of enrollment. *Please note that if you can't use your school email after graduation, you would face an issue with receiving CLO emails such as renewal notifications and any CLO news. *
content_description: This webpage provides essential information on how eligible students can access a 50% discount on CLO's Individual plan, including verification requirements and the application process.

title: Create and Edit Zipper
content: **List of Contents** Create Edit Unzip / Zip Set Options **** Create and Edit Zippers quickly and easily. **** #### **Create** 1. Click ![Zipper.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008480088) **Zipper** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click on the 3D garment or 2D Patterns where the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. →Based on the direction the cursor was moved, the segment where the Zipper appears is highlighted in light blue. 3. Double click on the desired endpoint for the Zipper. → One side of the Zipper is created. 4. Click on the Pattern outline where the other side of the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. → Based on the direction the cursor was moved, a blue point appears indicating the same length as the first half of the Zipper that was created. 5. Double click on the blue point. → The Zipper is now complete along with a Puller, a Slider, and a Stopper. 6. Activate the ![Toolbar_3D_Simulation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008384087) → The Zipper simulates being closed. While creating the zipper, press **Esc/C****trl+Z** to cancel all actions, or **Delete/Backspace** to undo the last action. #### **** #### **Edit** 1. Click **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/24447291991705)****Edit Zipper** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click the end point of the zipper ▶ Drag in direction to be edited, then Click on the end point of the opposite zipper ▶ Drag it the same way. → A blue dot is displayed at the same point as the opposite length. 3. Drag to the blue dot. → Both lengths of the zipper are modified. **** #### **Unzip / Zip** 1. Click ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976193305) Select/Move tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click & drag on the slider. → The selected slider is highlighted in yellow. 3. Continue to drag the slider. → The slider follows and moves along with the cursor. 4. Release the mouse at the desired position. → The slider is moved to the new location. 5. Activate the ![Toolbar_3D_Simulation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976206233) **Simulate** tool. → The zipper simulates and zips/unzips based on the new location. **** #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the 3D zipper using ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51925976193305) **Select/Move** tool. 2. Click an option as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete** | Delete the selected Zipper. **Reverse** | Reverse the sewing direction of the zipper tape on the side you right-clicked. **Flip Normal** | Flip the surface of the zipper tape on the side you right-clicked. **Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern** | ![20252.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/51928260813337) Duplicate the selected zipper to the corresponding symmetric pattern. This option is available only when the zipper is placed on a symmetric pattern or when it does not cross the center line of a half symmetric pattern. **Deactivate/ Freeze** | Deactivate or freeze the selected Zipper. **Reset Slider Arrangement** | Reset the slider's position and angle to default. **Show/Hide** | Show or hide the Slider/ Puller/ Stopper.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for quickly and easily creating, editing, and managing zippers in 3D garment design.

title: AI Render
content: **List of Contents** Open Compose Face Compose Background History ### **** Generate photorealistic artwork by compositing an AI-created or any portrait photo onto a realistically rendered garment. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162668825) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/lqPz6KmXMLI?t=56) Please note that AI Avatar Studio is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service. ### **** #### **Open** 1. Click Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ **AI Studio (Beta)**. **** #### **Compose Face ** * **Face Image** 1. 1. Click the ![Face.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162671257) **Face tab** at the top. **_**✨Tip:**_** When switching to the Face tab after compositing the background first, the result is automatically applied as the Target Image. This allows you to swap the face while keeping the background result. 2. Generate a face image to be composited by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Select gender, age, and ethnicity, and enter your prompt. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words. ** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more. ** If parentheses are used around a word you want to emphasize, it carries more weight. Weight increase rate: (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33834084288537)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Face image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33834073706265) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to load a face image that fits the following guidelines: * A close-up image of the front of the face with no parts covered by hair or shadows * A photo with a natural facial expression, no accessories covering the face, and no visible teeth. * A photo with a resolution of 1080 pixels or higher. * A photo with even lighting, no strong light, and no mirrors in the background. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583492915865)** * **Render and Result Image**** **** _**✨Tip:**_ ** In the CLO render window, when you run AI Avatar Studio immediately after the [Final Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render), it is automatically applied as a Target Image, which is more accurately analyzed and composited into a high-quality resulting image. 1. 1. Click the Upload button next to Target Image to load the render image to be composited. For more accurate analysis and results, it is recommended to use an image that fits the following guidelines: ▪️ High-resolution image (2160 to 4320 pixels recommended) ▪️ Well-focused and sharp image ▪️ Image with good contrast between objects and background. ▪️ Consistent lighting ▪️ Appropriately sized image 2. Click the **![Generate.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162673945)** Button. → The face image is composited into the render image, preserving the original garments, and then the resulting image is displayed. It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583492915865)** * **Refine Result Image ** You can refine the hair, hands, or garment details as needed to make the composite look more natural and realistic. 1. 1. 1. Click the ![hair.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46319783940249)**Hair,![hand.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46319752984345) Hands, ![garment.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46319752989209) Garment Details** buttons on the right side of the Output Image to refine them. 2. **📝****Note:** For garment details, adjustments are made to create a more realistic look, but patterns on the garments may become slightly distorted. **** ## ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583549985561)[![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162668825)](https://youtu.be/C-powOP-AwM?si=cIEfTMp_1xAWXJ9Q) #### **Compose Background** * **Background Image** 1. 1. Click the ![Background.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583124395161) **Background tab** at the top. **_✨Tip:_** When switching to the Background tab after compositing the Face first, the result is automatically applied as the Target Image. This allows you to compose the background while keeping the swapped face result. 2. Generate a background image to be composited by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Enter your prompt. **✨ Writing Tips:** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162677657)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33834084288537)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI background image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33834073706265) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly. **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to load a background image that fits the following guidelines: * A photo with a resolution of 1024 pixels or higher. * Choose a background that complements the tone and mood of the image. * Avoid busy or cluttered backgrounds that can distract from the subject. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583492915865)** * **Render and Result Image**** **** _**✨Tip:**_ ** In the CLO render window, when you run AI Avatar Studio immediately after the [Final Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render), it is automatically applied as a Target Image, which is more accurately analyzed and composited into a high-quality resulting image. 1. 1. Click the Upload button next to Target Image to load the render image to be composited. For more accurate analysis and results, it is recommended to use an image that fits the following guidelines: ▪️ High-resolution image (2160 to 4320 pixels recommended) ▪️ Well-focused and sharp image ▪️ Image with good contrast between objects and background. ▪️ Consistent lighting ▪️ Appropriately sized image 2. Click the **![Generate.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45583162673945)** Button. → The background image is composited into the target image, It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. **** #### **History** Generated images and prompts are automatically recorded in the history, where you can select and save any image as a file. The history will be cleared when the C software is closed.
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for using the AI Avatar Studio Beta, enabling users to generate photorealistic artwork by seamlessly compositing AI-generated faces and backgrounds onto rendered garments.

title: AI Texture Generator
content: **List of Contents** **Open** **Generate** **Apply** Easily type in keywords to generate different texture images to choose from to create new textures. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49992226377241) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0) **Open** 1. Click the Fabric tab in the Object Browser. 2. Fabric Property ▶ Materials ▶ Click ![AI Studio.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49992226380057)**AI Texture Generator button** on the right side of the Basic Parameters. → AI Texture Generator window appears. **Generate** 1. title: Edit Simulation Properties
content: ### **Objective** Configure the simulation properties for advanced scene settings. **Location ** Object Browser ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782471113753) Scene ▶ Environment ▶ **Simulation Properties** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → The simulation properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the simulation properties as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preset** | Instead of selecting the [simulation mode](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000304968-Simulation) from the 3D toolbar, you can choose predefined presets here. Normal, Fitting, and GPU simulations are primarily used. **Time Step** | This determines the time values calculated within the simulation engine. The smaller you set it, the more sophisticated it will be, but it will also require more calculations and will, resultingly, be slower. The default values are recommended. **Number of Simulation** | When calculating cloth simulation for a given time step, this denotes how many substeps one simulation calculation is divided into. For example, if you are calculating a time step of 0.03 and number of simulation is 10, the actual time step will be 0.003. Simulating multiple times with these smaller time intervals ensures both more numerically accurate results and stable collision handling, but takes much longer. **CG Finish Condition, CG Iteration Count, CG Residual** | Clothing simulation is the process of solving a large linear system. Large linear systems can be solved using a numerical analysis method called conjugate gradient method (CG). CG improves the accuracy of the answer through iterative calculations. The condition for CG ending can be set by the number of iterations or when the error (=residual) falls below a certain value. Iteration: Because it repeats only a certain number of times and ends unconditionally, it is faster but may be less accurate. Residual: It is slower but can be more accurate because it stops when the error falls below a certain value. **Self Collision Iteration Count** | Defines the number of collision calculations for the clothing. More collision calculations produce more precise results, but they are also slower. Please use the default value. **Air Damping** | The resistance that the garment receives from the air. **Gravity** | Defines the most important gravity values in your simulation. If this value is adjusted, simulation results will become unrealistic. Please use the default value, unless you want to, for example, create a weightless simulation. **Number of CPU in Use** | This determines the number of physical cores within the CPU that will be used for the simulation. CLO can technically use up to 12 cores, which are automatically defined based on your computer. Even if it is a high-end CPU with 16 cores, up to 12 can be used. This may vary depending on the CPU manufacturer and actual CPU products. This value is best also left at default. **Nonlinear Simulation** | Linear or non-linear is an important factor in all fields of computer graphics, simulation, rendering and engineering. By analogy, the real world is non-linear, but computer implementations are linear. Nonlinearity is a technique that makes things look very real, and simulating them this way is sophisticated, but slow. If Fitting simulation is run, this option is selected. t's slower because it's more complicated and requires a lot of calculations. **Ground, Avatar-Cloth Collision Detection, Self-Collision Detection, Proximity Detection** | All of these are intended to simulate collisions and friction between the clothing and the avatar. Because CLO calculates numerous contacts and collisions between the fabric and the body, the simulation looks natural and realistic. It is recommended that these values are also left at their default. **※Note:** **Use the Open & Save buttons on the top of the Property Editor to save, open, and reuse the settings.**
content_description: This web page provides guidance on configuring advanced simulation properties for realistic scene settings in the CLO 3D software.

title: I get an error message saying, "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time" or "Delayed network connection." What can I do?
content: **Question** I get an error message saying, "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time" or "Delayed network connection." What can I do? **Answer** There are six possible cases for this issue. Please see them below and adopt appropriate solution. * **Due to internet disconnection** * Please connect to the internet and try logging in again. * **Due to slow internet speed when connecting to CLO authentication server.** * Please change your authentication type by [contacting us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to an anti-virus program** * An anti-virus of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please uninstall the anti-virus program and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to a user PC's firewall setting** * The firewall setting of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please unblock the firewall and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please[ contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to a user's company's firewall setting** * Sometimes, a company may have a firewall setting interfere with CLO. Please check with in-house IT team. * **Due to a user's proxy server setting** * Please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact) for the help.
content_description: Find solutions to common login issues related to network problems, including internet disconnections, slow speeds, and firewall settings.

title: Troubleshooting: Vray Render Problems
content: This article describes the causes and solutions to various problems that may occur during V-ray rendering in CLO software. If your CLO rendering is not working, freezing or extremely slow, please take a closer look at this article. And please note that this article does not describe everything related to rendering, but rather describes the main causes of problems and how to mitigate them. ![Lady_in_Hanbok_png.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44490647923481) <The image above is an example of a traditional woman dress rendered using V-ray in CLO software.> ## **Technical background** CLO software includes the [V-Ray Render SDK from Chaos](https://www.chaos.com/vray), allowing users to create photorealistic renders of their projects, including clothing and avatars. CLO's V-ray renderer supports both Windows and macOS, and can complete rendering faster via GPU acceleration, especially on Windows PCs equipped with Nvidia graphics cards. On Windows PCs and Macs without an Nvidia graphics card, rendering will be done via the CPU, and the results of CPU-based and GPU-based rendering will be almost identical. And one good news, starting with CLO v2025.0, GPU acceleration is available for V-ray rendering on Apple Silicon Macs. In the Render Engine list, you can choose GPU (Metal) in addition to CPU. Also note that acceleration performance via GPU (Metal) depends on the specifications of the GPU cores built into the Apple Silicon Mac and the CLO garment file and its properties. ## **Render Properties** ![004_render_properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44375524368025) ### Render Engine * **CPU** : This is the default render engine for CLO and will be locked to this engine on Windows PCs and Macs without Nvidia graphics cards. * **GPU (CUDA)** : This is an option for Windows PCs with Nvidia graphics cards. If you have a modern, high-performance Nvidia GPU, you can complete rendering about 2 to 6 times faster than CPU-based rendering. When rendering very light clothing, like a basic CLO t-shirt, there isn't much difference between GPU and CPU render times. GPU rendering is an option to choose when you want to process very complex and heavy garments quickly, and to do so, you need the latest high-performance Nvidia GPUs. * **CPU Supporting** : This feature adds idle CPU resources during GPU rendering to help render faster and smoother. We recommend leaving this option turned on. * **Low GPU Priority** : This will lower the GPU resources consumed during GPU rendering. You can turn this option on if you want to do other image/video work while rendering, but for fast and stable rendering, you may want to leave it off. ### Finish Conditions * Finish Conditions are literally options that determine how the render will be finished. * **Noise Threshold** : This determines how much noise will be suppressed in the rendered result image. The lower this value is, the better the rendered image quality is. However, as more calculations are performed, computing resources and rendering time increase dramatically. **Even with the default value of 0.05, sufficient quality rendering results can be obtained.** If you want to obtain better quality rendered images, try rendering while lowering this value step by step, like 0.05 > 0.04 > 0.03, and check the final quality. At the lowest values ​​near 0.001, it will take a long time to complete the render even on a high-performance computer. * **Max Render Time (min)** : This is a kind of timer, and when the time set here is elapsed, the render engine will stop even if the rendering has not completed yet. Lowering this value will not make rendering complete any faster. So if you set this value too low, you may see a rough rendered image result because it will stop in an unfinished rendering state. **It is actually better to set it to the maximum value of 100 minutes.** ## **Image/Video Properties** ![003_render_image_properties.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44374636184729) ### Image Size * As the image size increases, the amount of pixels the renderer has to process (i.e. the amount of computation) increases, which in turn increases the usage of the CPU, GPU, video memory, main memory, and the time to complete. If you want to render very large image sizes, make sure your computer is powerful enough to handle it, especially with plenty of memory. Most rendering scenarios can be handled well on a PC with around 32GB of memory and/or around 16GB of video memory, but scenarios such as super large image sizes or animation rendering may run into memory shortage issues. * If you need to continuously process sequential image scenes, such as turntable rendering, animation rendering, and colorway rendering, the load on your hardware and memory usage can increase significantly. Even in rendering scenarios that process sequential scenes like this, keep a close eye on memory usage. ## **Interactive Render vs. Final Render** * Interactive Render is a function that instantly renders changes to the scene that occur when you rotate or scale a garment in the 3D window, showing them within the Render window. That is, since it is a mode for fast and instantaneous rendering results, the image quality and details are reduced compared to Final Render. * Final Render is a function that renders based on the current garment and given render settings and saves the result as an image file or video. Even after Final Render is completed, you need to check the result saved as a file, not the result shown in the render window, to confirm the exact rendered result. Additionally, slight differences in image quality, color, and color tone may occur depending on the image/video viewer program. ## **Problem situations and how to solve them** * **"My computer has an Nvidia graphics card but GPU rendering is not enabled"** : This is either because the GPU device is disabled in Windows, the graphics card and monitor are not properly connected, or because of a graphics card driver error. Please check [this web post](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768-Graphics-Card-Problems-and-Troubleshooting) for solutions. * **"Can't render with Intel Graphics or AMD GPU?"** : CLO software supports both CPU and GPU rendering, with GPU rendering only available on PCs with Nvidia graphics cards and Apple Silicon Macs. Windows PCs with AMD or Intel graphics cards, and older Intel-chip-based Macs, only support CPU rendering. * **"So slow, rendering has been taking hours"** : Depending on how complex and heavy your project is, your computer's specifications, and the Render Finish Conditions described above, the render completion time will vary. Try rendering again after loosening the details and properties of the garment itself, as well as the render properties. * **"Freezing or crash happens while rendering"** : As above, it is a result of the complexity of the project, computer specifications, and rendering properties. Sometimes, crashes or rendering failures may occur due to graphics card driver errors, in which case, try updating to the latest graphics card drivers. * **"It shows out of video memory error"** : This occurs when there is not enough video memory to complete the rendering. Please readjust the render properties and image size, close all other programs using video memory, and then try rendering again. For example, starting Windows and opening just a web browser can take up about 600MB to 1GB of video memory. Under these conditions, if your graphics card has 8GB of video memory, your CLO will only be able to use about 7GB of video memory. So if you are running multiple programs in addition to the CLO software, it is recommended that you close them before rendering, as the CLO renderer may run out of video memory. * **"Rendering stops with an unknown error message"** : This is due to a setting error in Windows itself and/or a graphics card driver error. Update to the latest graphics card driver. * **"Garments containing fur and/or knitwear fabrics cannot be rendered, or it shows unexpected render results"** : Fur and knitwear rendering are among the most hardware-intensive of CLO's features. They require several to tens of times more calculations and use more memory than other clothing renderings. If your computer is struggling to handle this scenario, consider designing approaches that use images or textures to represent fur and knitwear. * **"GPU render results are slightly different from CPU render results"** : This is due to the nature of the V-Ray render SDK and may occur when rendering scenes with a large number of light sources and reflections, and very complex fabrics such as fur. This is a known issue for the CLO team and are continuously working on improving it. * **"V-Ray render cannot run because the required V-Ray library could not be loaded in the current environment"** : The CLO software is designed to load configuration files when starting vray-render. This error indicates that essential files for vray-render could not be loaded due to file permissions. The solution is to install the CLO software with administrator privileges, see [details here](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697-Disk-access-rights-required-when-CLO-is-running#:~:text=to%20download%22%20appears.-,Windows,-1%C2%A0%20After%20logging). Security programs, such as antivirus programs, may restrict the execution of the CLO software or various files that comprise CLO. In the detailed settings of the installed or running security program, change both the execution of the CLO software and Internet connection to "Allow." ![008_vray_lib_load_fail.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/54219419608473) ## **How to check GPU and video memory usage** * You can check CPU, Memory, GPU, and GPU memory usage in the Performance tab of Windows Task Manager. Below, running just Windows and a web browser, you can see very low CPU and GPU usage, but you can see that the base memory usage is quite high. * When you run CLO to perform tasks like pattern editing, simulation, rendering, etc., you will see increased CPU, GPU, and memory usage. And it is normal for CPU and GPU usage to be close to 100% during simulation and rendering, and GPU usage will not stay at 100% during GPU-rendering. While GPU rendering, GPU usage continues to fluctuate because it is divided into sections where the GPU works, sections where the CPU works, and sections where they work simultaneously. ![007_GPU_usage.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44417445932569) The image above is what Windows Task Manager looks like during interactive-GPU-rendering. The Windows desktop PC specifications and project file details used for testing are as follows: * AMD Ryzen™ 9 7950X Processor (native 16-core), Nvidia RTX™ A6000 (vram 48GB), 64GB DDR5 memory, NVMe SSD 512GB, 4K resolution monitor, wired internet connection * Windows 11 Pro version 24H2 (OS Build 26100.3476), CLO v2024.2.328 * A traditional dress made of multiple layers, particle distance from 5 to 20, no trim, made with 55 patterns and 1144 sewing lines. Check out the links below for file download and tutorial. * CONNECT store: <https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/99263/collection/collections?itemId=5af7734d050c4e31987061fbf697a3a9> * YouTube tutorial: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T_UbvoshTpA> **1) CPU** : shows CPU usage. It doesn't always use 100% during rendering and it fluctuates. **2) Memory** : this is the total amount of memory used by Windows, the web browser, and CLO rendering. Windows itself uses about 4GB of memory, and the web browser uses about the same amount. The CLO software uses about 5 to 6GB of memory to do this level of garment rendering. Memory usage will vary depending on OS, hardware configuration, active programs, CLO garment files, and properties. **3) GPU** : shows GPU name and current usage. If you have a laptop or desktop with both integrated graphics and a discrete graphics card, you will see more than one GPU listed. As with CPU usage, it is not always 100% and fluctuates. **4) Dedicated GPU Memory** : shows the total amount of video memory installed on the graphics card and the currently used amount. Windows itself typically uses about 600MB to 1GB of video memory, and web browsers and other programs with graphical UI use a similar amount of video memory. Rendering in CLO typically starts at around 3GB of video memory, and can even use 20GB or more for very complex, continuous image processing scenarios such as animation rendering. Mac users who want to check hardware resources while running CLO software can use the [Activity Monitor](https://support.apple.com/guide/activity-monitor/welcome/mac) app which built in macOS. ## **See also** * [CLO system requirements](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168-CLO-system-requirements-March-2025) * [Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768-Graphics-Card-Problems-and-Troubleshooting) * [How to workaround errors caused by faulty GPU drivers](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/44142966593177-How-to-workaround-errors-caused-by-faulty-GPU-drivers-Last-modified-Mar-2025) * [How to speed up CLO](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/23390057463577-How-to-Speed-Up-CLO)

title: CLO AI Chat History Feature
content: **Question** What is the Chat History Feature? How can I use the Chat History Feature? **Answer** * The AI chat history feature allows users to access previous conversations with the chatbot at any time and continue the dialogue. * This feature is available to anyone who subscribes to CLO or CLO-SET paid plans, and can be accessed from the left panel after logging into the AI chatbot. * Even if the subscription is canceled, the conversations recorded in the chatbot are not deleted, although the chat history feature will be disabled. * If the subscription is reactivated, users will be able to view their previous chat history again. If you encounter any issues while using the Chat History feature, please feel free to [contact us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus).
content_description: Discover the Chat History Feature, which allows subscribers to revisit and continue past conversations with our AI chatbot, ensuring seamless interactions anytime you log in.
